programme.desc: FrightFest Presents. A brutal, gore-tastic slasher/survival horror, in the vein of The Texas Chainsaw Massacre and Wolf Creek. While on a road trip a couple decide to stop at a diner. Little do they know that ordering a hamburger will have terrible consequences. Their journey soon becomes a harrowing story of survival as they are kidnapped by local farmers. On their farm, humans are the main dish.

programme.title: Domino
programme.desc: Starring Game of Thrones' Nikolaj Coster-Waldau, Carice van Houten and Guy Pearce this is a thrilling race-against-time. In a world wracked by terror and suspicion, police officer Christian seeks justice for his partner's murder by an ISIS member. On the hunt for the killer, Christian and a fellow cop become caught in a game of cat and mouse, with a duplicitous CIA agent.

programme.title: At First Light
programme.desc: The producer of Midnight Special and Sinister 2 bring you this supernatural, coming-of-age thriller. High school senior, Alex (Stefanie Scott: Beautiful Boy, Insidious Chapter 3), has a paranormal experience in her hometown, which leaves her with dangerous, supernatural abilities but no recollection of who she is or how she got her powers until she comes across her friend Sean, who offers to take her in. However, when a mysterious organization with questionable motives tracks her down, the two are forced to run away, embarking on an adventure to unearth the truth of what actually transpired that one night.

programme.title: Hello Carter
programme.desc: This witty, charming, feel-good comedy, stars Jodie Whittaker (Doctor Who) and Charlie Cox (Daredevil). Carter is a homeless, unemployed, single, twenty-something Londoner. Desperate to get his life back on track, he wants to win back his elusive ex-girlfriend Kelly (Annabelle Wallis), but learns that the road to happiness can be unpredictable, unconventional and unbelievably funny.

programme.title: Blame
programme.desc: This award-winning, coming-of-age drama stars Quinn Shephard (The Miseducation of Cameron Post). When the new drama teacher casts Abigail over Melissa in their adaptation of Arthur Miller's The Crucible, Abigail's confidence and relationship with him blooms. Fuelled by jealousy, Melissa spirals out of control and concocts a vengeful plot against Abigail. A raw, scandalous fight like no other!

programme.title: A Call to Spy
programme.desc: Inspired by incredible true stories. At the beginning of WWII Churchill orders his new spy agency to recruit women as spies to build a resistance. SOEs spymistress Vera Atkins (Stana Katic), recruits Virginia Hall (Sarah Megan Thomas), an ambitious American with a wooden leg and Noor Inayat Khan (Radhika Apte), a Muslim pacifist, who leave an unmistakable legacy in their wake.

programme.title: Fall of a Kingdom
programme.desc: Game of Thrones meets Braveheart. This historical actioner follows a 13th century freedom fighters as they battle for their lives and liberty in the face of the brutal Mongolian Empire. As war breaks out, both sides suffer devastation. Redoubling his efforts, Burunda Khan the Mongolian general - unleashes the full fury of his force. Starring Robert Patrick, Tommy Flanagan and Poppy Drayton.

programme.title: The Beat Beneath my Feet
programme.desc: With a School of Rock-esque vibe, this hilarious coming-of-age tale explores unconventional friendship in the most riotous way. When nerdy teen Tom meets rebellious American rock legend Max (Luke Perry), he knows this is his chance to fulfil his dreams. Tom agrees not to report the 'presumed dead' Max to the authorities...on the basis that he teaches him how to play guitar.

programme.title: Killerman
programme.desc: When NYC money launderer Moe Diamond (Liam Hemsworth - The Hunger Games) wakes up from a car crash, he's left with no memory, millions in stolen cash, and an insane crew of dirty cops hunting him down. With a stranger (Emory Cohen - Lords of Chaos) who says he's his best friend and a fiance he doesn't remember, Moe must race against the clock to discover his own identity and escape his past.

programme.title: Superbob
programme.desc: Superbob is a hilarious and touching new twist on the superhero genre starring legendary British comedian Catherine Tate (The Office). 7 years ago Robert Kenner, a mild mannered postman from Peckham, South London was struck by a meteor which bestowed him with super powers. 6 years later, Bob finally gets a day off from his superhero duties and tries to get a shot at love

programme.title: The Beast
programme.desc: After the mutilated body of a missing girl is discovered in the tidelands of Incheon, rivals Han-su and Min-tae, are in charge of finding the culprit. Things take a dark turn when Han-su meets an informant who insists he knows who the murderer is. As cover-ups and secret deals ensue, tensions rise between the two detectives as the pressure of solving the crime is shaking up the Korean peninsula.

programme.title: St Agatha
programme.desc: St Agatha is a twisted horror thriller which pushes the boundaries of the nunsploitation genre from Darren Lynn Bousman, the director of Saw II, III and IV. In 1950s Georgia, a pregnant con woman on the run seeks refuge in a desolate convent only to be met with an unsettling and horrendous evil waiting on the other side. Enter this convent at your own risk!

programme.title: June
programme.desc: Dark. Demonic. Disturbing. Nine-year-old orphan June has been found a new adoptive family. What her new parents do not know is that June is possessed by an ancient dark spirit named Aer. As the evil Aer plans to destroy everything, will June be able to save her new family and herself? In the vein of The Omen and Orphan, this chilling supernatural cult horror is a genre classic and one not to miss.

programme.title: The Furies
programme.desc: FrightFest Presents. The Furies is Halloween meets The Hunger Games in this gripping & fast paced female-driven survival thriller. A young woman faces her darkest fears with seven other unwilling participants in a deadly game. A game that can only have one winner.

programme.title: Wrong Turn
programme.desc: A nightmare befalls a group of friends on the Appalachian trail in this iconic franchise reboot from the original creator Alan. B. McElroy. While on a dream trip, a group finds themselves at the mercy of an urban legend - The Foundation. As a freak accident drives the group deeper into the mountains, they find themselves succumbing one by one in a gruesome game of survival.

programme.title: The Guardian
programme.desc: Little Miss Sunshine meets The Blind Side. Even losers can win! When an unlucky car salesman (Andy Garcia) finds himself thrown into caring for a homeless grifter (Dafne Keen) they embark on a cross country road trip to find her father. Loan sharks, side hustles and a lot of fun along the way, this car salesman soon discovers an old dog can learn new tricks.

programme.title: Office Uprising
programme.desc: Get ready for the worst work day ever in this absurdly funny zombie infestation! An underachiever (Brenton Thwaites: Pirates of the Caribbean: Salazars Revenge) working at a weapons manufacturing firm must rescue his one true love from psychotic zombie co-workers who have been weaponized by Zolt, a new energy drink. Co-starring Jane Levy (Dont Breathe) and Karan Soni (Deadpool).

programme.title: Survivor
programme.desc: Alone, stranded and deadly. This thrilling Sci-Fi sees Kate Mitra, a beautiful young astronaut who detects a faint radio transmission from a planet within a nearby wormhole. Is this first contact with a friendly alien race? Or a harbinger of unimaginable terror? She quickly discovers that the terrifying inhabitants of the planet will stop at nothing to prevent them from leaving.

programme.title: Valhalla: Legend of Thor
programme.desc: No man, woman or child may defy the gods. When Thor and Loki seek refuge in the home of mortals, the youngest son fails to heed a warning from the gods. As atonement for the family's sins, the gods take the two youngest children under their wing and embark on an epic adventure from Midgard to Valhalla that will see them stare down ruthless giants, barbaric gods and the dreaded wolf Fenrir.

programme.title: Robot Overlords
programme.desc: Welcome to the ultimate battle between robots and mankind! When teenager Sean (Callan McAuliffe: The Great Gatsby) sets out to join the Resistance, against the robots, the fate of the world lies in his hands. Hot on his heels however, is robot collaborator Mr. Smythe (Ben Kingsley: Iron Man 3). This exhilarating British sci-fi thriller, delivers a bombastic robot takeover that is not to be missed!

programme.title: A Kid Like Jake
programme.desc: A heart-breaking family drama starring Claire Danes, Jim Parsons and Octavia Spencer. Parents, Alex and Greg are approaching an important crossroads - finding the "right" primary school for their son, Jake, a precocious four-year-old who happens to prefer Disney princesses to G.I. Joe. However, as Jake's behaviour becomes increasingly erratic and perplexing, a rift begins to emerge between them.

programme.title: Killing Field
programme.desc: Drugs. Money. Greed. Death. When a drug bust goes horribly wrong, David (Bruce Willis - Die Hard) , a decorated cop, finds himself at the mercy of a drug cartel. As the violent gang seeks refuge on farmland they soon discover one man (Chad Michael Murray - Riverdale) with a deadly aim who stands between them and freedom. Welcome to the Killing Field.

programme.title: 12 Hour Shift
programme.desc: One night, do no harm for one junkie nurse thats not an oath shes willing to keep. Mandy (Angela Bettis - May) finds herself beholden to a gang of organ-traffickers (David Arquette - The Scream Franchise, Mick Foley - WWE) and when a kidney goes missing she's going to do whatever it takes. Throw in to the mix a strung out cousin with bad judgement and the bodies begin to pile up.

programme.title: Rise of the Viking
programme.desc: From the director of epic fantasy, Black Sails and starring Breaking Bad's Jonathan Banks comes this historical actioner perfect for all Game of Thrones fans. 754 AD- during a time of epic battles and bloodshed, the legend of the pagan warrior king Redbad is born, but so is a new weapon against his people: Christianity. Redbad must unite a Viking army to defeat the seemingly invincible Franks.

programme.title: Outlaws and Angels
programme.desc: Bone Tomahawk meets Little House on the Left in this gritty home-invasion western. In 1887, three violent fugitives hold a family hostage in their isolated New Mexico farmhouse, leading to a game of seduction, role reversal and bloody revenge. A gun-slinging western starring Chad Michael Murray (One Tree Hill), Luke Wilson (The Ridiculous 6) and Francesca Eastwood (True Crime).

programme.title: Terror on the Prairie
programme.desc: True Grit meets The Handmaid’s Tale in this highly-unsettling and ruthlessly vicious female-led western thriller. On the Montana plains, a frontier woman must protect herself against a ruthless gang of outlaws hell-bent on revenge. Starring Gina Carano (The Mandalorian), Samaire Armstrong (The O.C), Nick Searcy (The Shape of Water), and Gabriel-Kane Day Lewis (Daniel Day Lewis’ son).

programme.desc: During the California Gold Rush, an Indiana farmer's obsession for gold leads him deep into the wilderness. As years pass and fortunes rise and fall, his pursuit may cost him the things that matter most-love, friendship, and peace of mind.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: Wells Fargo detective James Hume hires private investigator Harry Morse to join the hunt for Black Bart. Known as the Poet Highwayman, Bart leaves tantalizing poems at the scenes of his crimes, which may be the key to unmasking Bart's true identity.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Joe and Hoss travel to Sacramento to visit Helen, the widow of Ben's friend, Josh Layton. Hoss falls in love with her and intends to marry her. All are thrilled except Adam, who has reason to believe that she is using Hoss.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: After Marshal Ed Masterson is shot while breaking up a barroom brawl, he hastily bans all firearms in Dodge City. Ed's swift proclamation is met with disdain by most townsfolk, including his own brothers, and places an even larger target on his back.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: After Marshal Ed Masterson is gunned down in Dodge City, his youngest brother, James, decides to follow in his footsteps and become a lawman. But when James' life is threatened, middle brother Bat Masterson races back from Arizona to protect his kin.

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier
programme.desc: While coming of age on America's frontier, Kit Carson sets a new standard for steely nerves and fearlessness. But his legend is born when a Native woman is insulted by a notorious bully of the mountains, and Kit challenges the man to a duel to death.

programme.title: Ultimate Cowboy Showdown
programme.desc: Season two of Ultimate Cowboy Showdown kicks off with the arrival of fourteen real-life cowboys to the sprawling Texas ranch where they'll call home until only one remains. As they set up camp in the sweltering heat, they make their introductions and size up the competition. While getting better acquainted, personalities clash, and alliances form. In the first of many challenges, the cowboys work in teams to sort gold-tagged cattle from a mixed herd. When miscommunication affects a team's performance, they have to answer to Trace. After consulting with two expert judges, Trace eliminates the team member who didn't pull their weight. As the eliminated contestant hits the trail, the remaining thirteen breathe a sigh of relief and prepare for the next challenge.

programme.title: Ultimate Cowboy Showdown
programme.desc: The thirteen remaining cowboys face their first immunity challenge that tests their individual skills. The contestants race to score the fastest time in barrel racing and calf roping. While most cowboys impress Trace and the judges, only one will be safe from the next elimination. For the team challenge, the cowboys take on a group of untrained horses that they have to break, saddle, and ride. In the end, it all comes down to strategy, and the team that thinks ahead takes the win. After a few choice words, teammates lock horns, determined to out-cowboy the other. When an unexpected cowboy heads home, the rest of the contestants realize every move they make counts in this competition.

programme.title: Handcrafted America
programme.desc: Host Jill Wagner travels the country on a quest to find talented craftsmen who still make incredible items by hand. Jill's first stop is the hat shop of John and Kate McLaughlin in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, where the couple shows her how they make 21st century hats using 18th century tools and technology. Next, she travels to Santa Cruz, California, to hang out with Cody Dumont, a woodworker who makes longbows that draw as much admiration for their looks as their precision with arrows. Also in Santa Cruz, Martijn Stiphout, uses castoff wood from other woodworkers to build hollow wooden surfboards.

programme.title: State Plate
programme.desc: Taylor heads to Arkansas, home of many unique inventions, including the spring-based rocking horse, the talking part of talking pictures and the invention of a distinctly American cheese dip! Taylor stirs up the world champion Five Families cheese dip appetizer with its winning chef. Next, he takes off in a tractor in the sky to see how Arkansas grows more rice than any other state. He's rewarded with a side dish of long-grain white rice smothered with butter. Taylor then indulges in another tasty invention, the fried dill pickle. He visits a thoroughbred racetrack that's a haven for savory corned beef sandwiches. But The Natural State has one more sweet surprise for Taylor: a dessert known as possum pie that, despite its name, hides pure chocolaty goodness.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: A young bank robber decides to get a job at the Ponderosa with the Cartwrights in an attempt to prevent the local sheriff from learning the whereabouts of his accomplices, known as the feared Pardo gang.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: While Express Agent Jeff Milton is guarding a payroll safe on a train, he is shot by a gang of bandits, and his left arm is nearly shattered. A Tucson surgeon races against the clock to save Milton's life and to save his arm from amputation.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: Deputy James Masterson and a group of lawmen from Ingalls, Kansas, attempt to seize the official county seal from the nearby town of Cimarron. Their raid turns deadly when a mob of angry townspeople open fire to defend the Cimarron courthouse.

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier
programme.desc: After Anne Bailey's husband is killed by Native Americans, she defies the social norms of the frontier and becomes a horseback courier, risking her life to race through hostile territory delivering vital supplies to isolated forts and settlements.

programme.title: The Cowboy Way
programme.desc: First, the cowboys need to track down one of Bubba's most troublesome heifers before she can bust through his fence again. After briefly tending to business and family in Alabama, the guys head back to the Lone Star State to try and expand their network of contacts. Bubba, Cody, and Booger help their new friend Cash with a big Texas cattle drive in the hopes of both leading the herd to greener pastures and finding the big cattle deal they came west for. On the range they forge deeper bonds with their Texas counterparts, swapping cowboy stories around the campfire. But things take a turn for the worse when the herd overheats, and the creek they're all counting on has run dry as a bone. Back home, Jaclyn and Matthew are learning to love life on the ranch. Houseguest Andrew's disgusting habits have Kaley seeing red. And just as Misty gets back in the barrel-racing saddle, she starts to butt heads with her high-strung mare.

programme.title: Suddenly
programme.desc: Three gangsters converge on a small town and invade a family home on the top of a hill near the railroad station. They are planning to assassinate the President of the United States. - This classic suspense film will keep you on the edge of your seat.

programme.title: The Tall Tales of Jim Bridger
programme.desc: When they are ambushed by a Blackfeet war party, Jim Bridger and a lone Shoshone brave must work together to find a way to defeat their common enemy. If they can't overcome their suspicions and learn to trust each other, they may not survive the day.

programme.title: Handcrafted America
programme.desc: Host Jill Wagner travels the country on a quest to find talented craftsmen who still make incredible items by hand. Her first stop is Charlotte, North Carolina, where designer Stan Fraser is making custom-fitted blue jeans using traditional techniques and high quality selvedge denim. Further north in Boston, furniture maker Paula Garbarino shows Jill how she uses the art of marquetry to create a painterly effect with paper-thin wood veneers. Finally, in Portland, Oregon, Jill visits the workshop of Chris Cardy, an entrepreneur who fabricates stylish steel and wood beds that can be customized to fit any customer's exacting standards.

programme.title: State Plate
programme.desc: Host Taylor Hicks gets a little salty when State Plate heads to Utah. First, he heads 5000 feet underground and jumps into the world's biggest salt grinder to mine the purest salt in the country. From there he starts his plate with a savory salt-crusted beef tenderloin. Next, Taylor goes for three side dishes that shout family and flavor. He discovers the many ways you can prepare Utah's official snack: Jell-O. Then he shares the secret behind the state's famous fry-sauce. And what in the world are funeral potatoes? Taylor finds a comforting casserole that's simply to die for. Finally, he feels the heat as he learns how to preserve Utah's celebrated cherry crop, and treats himself to tart cherry cookies that are simply divine.

programme.title: Legends of the Pony Express
programme.desc: Heroic Pony Express riders and station keepers face deadly terrain, hostile Native Americans, and dangerous outlaws to deliver vital mail across the untamed frontier. Their life-and-death adventures unite the country and become the stuff of legends.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: Soon after ranch hand Frank Hamer joins the Texas Rangers, he helps them hunt down a mysterious killer, takes part in his first gunfight, and demonstrates a natural gift for detective work that launches a legendary career in law enforcement.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: After frontier physician Doctor Susan Anderson accepts a marriage proposal, she finds herself juggling wedding arrangements and a life-or-death medical case. As her wedding day approaches, Doc Susie is forced to choose between love and medicine.

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier
programme.desc: When Chief Pontiac organizes a coalition of Native American tribes to attack British forts, frontier trader George Croghan risks his life on a perilous journey into the wilderness to find Pontiac, negotiate a peace agreement, and prevent all-out war.

programme.title: The Cowboy Way
programme.desc: Bubba, Booger and Cody take an important step toward becoming big-time cattle brokers! The guys are roping and doctoring yearlings on the Texas range. But when Booger's most reliable horse Studly trips, smashing both horse and rider to the ground, Booger must rush out to find a vet and tend to his injured horse. Just as the cowboys are about to leave Texas, a local rancher makes them an offer they can't refuse. Will the guys gamble on a cattle deal, taking on a herd before they have a buyer lined up? Back home in Alabama, Kaley's patience reaches a breaking point as houseguest Andrew tracks in mud and expects a free lunch. To top it off, he then asks if his whole family can crash there while he searches for a permanent residence. Misty finds some extra help with her troublesome barrel-racing horse. Booger and Matthew are on the hunt for the perfect one-year anniversary gift for Jaclyn. But Booger may have a special surprise up his sleeve.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Tom Edwards is in a wheelchair and holds Ben Cartwright responsible for his condition. When Tom turns to drinking to ease his pain, the Cartwrights work together to help him find purpose in his life again.

programme.title: Once Upon a Texas Train
programme.desc: An outlaw and a Texas Ranger have a life-long personal feud, but now, as grumpy older men, they must put their differences aside and face a common problem - a young gang of outlaws ravaging Texas.

programme.title: The Cowboy Way
programme.desc: While the cowboys are sorting the herd, Cody suffers a close call on the job that sets off a string of bad luck as he plans his annual rodeo, Bulls on the Beach. He struggles to impress a potential sponsor and the entire event is put in jeopardy when the bulls don't arrive as scheduled. Bubba heads to Mississippi to work for his father-in-law and try his hand at office life. Booger and Jaclyn enjoy learning the first dance for their wedding, but Booger finds himself awkwardly out of place as the only man at their bridal shower!

programme.title: The Cowboy Way
programme.desc: Bubba, Cody, and Booger have their work cut out for them removing a dangerous cow from a local rancher's herd. Bubba continues to shadow his father-in-law, making his first business pitch to a potential client. programme.desc: Soon after ranch hand Frank Hamer joins the Texas Rangers, he helps them hunt down a mysterious killer, takes part in his first gunfight, and demonstrates a natural gift for detective work that launches a legendary career in law enforcement.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: After frontier physician Doctor Susan Anderson accepts a marriage proposal, she finds herself juggling wedding arrangements and a life-or-death medical case. As her wedding day approaches, Doc Susie is forced to choose between love and medicine.

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier
programme.desc: When Chief Pontiac organizes a coalition of Native American tribes to attack British forts, frontier trader George Croghan risks his life on a perilous journey into the wilderness to find Pontiac, negotiate a peace agreement, and prevent all-out war.

programme.title: The Cowboy Way
programme.desc: Bubba, Booger and Cody take an important step toward becoming big-time cattle brokers! The guys are roping and doctoring yearlings on the Texas range. But when Booger's most reliable horse Studly trips, smashing both horse and rider to the ground, Booger must rush out to find a vet and tend to his injured horse. Just as the cowboys are about to leave Texas, a local rancher makes them an offer they can't refuse. Will the guys gamble on a cattle deal, taking on a herd before they have a buyer lined up? Back home in Alabama, Kaley's patience reaches a breaking point as houseguest Andrew tracks in mud and expects a free lunch. To top it off, he then asks if his whole family can crash there while he searches for a permanent residence. Misty finds some extra help with her troublesome barrel-racing horse. Booger and Matthew are on the hunt for the perfect one-year anniversary gift for Jaclyn. But Booger may have a special surprise up his sleeve.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Tom Edwards is in a wheelchair and holds Ben Cartwright responsible for his condition. When Tom turns to drinking to ease his pain, the Cartwrights work together to help him find purpose in his life again.

programme.title: Once Upon a Texas Train
programme.desc: An outlaw and a Texas Ranger have a life-long personal feud, but now, as grumpy older men, they must put their differences aside and face a common problem - a young gang of outlaws ravaging Texas.

programme.title: The Cowboy Way
programme.desc: While the cowboys are sorting the herd, Cody suffers a close call on the job that sets off a string of bad luck as he plans his annual rodeo, Bulls on the Beach. He struggles to impress a potential sponsor and the entire event is put in jeopardy when the bulls don't arrive as scheduled. Bubba heads to Mississippi to work for his father-in-law and try his hand at office life. Booger and Jaclyn enjoy learning the first dance for their wedding, but Booger finds himself awkwardly out of place as the only man at their bridal shower!

programme.title: The Cowboy Way
programme.desc: Bubba, Cody, and Booger have their work cut out for them removing a dangerous cow from a local rancher's herd. Bubba continues to shadow his father-in-law, making his first business pitch to a potential client. He begins to realize a life in Mississippi could prove to be very lucrative, but he isn't ready to hang up his spurs just yet. Misty convinces Cody to let her have his ranch horse for her new cattle business, requiring Cody and Booger to train a replacement colt for Cody. Booger and Jaclyn find wedding planning to be more troublesome than they anticipated.

programme.title: Vengeance Valley
programme.desc: A Colorado rancher contends with his two sons, one biological and the other adopted, who are fighting over control of the massive family property. Which brother will come out on top in this family battle for cash and cattle?

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Captain Pender is looking for a scout and Hoss suggests former scout Charlie Trent. Charlie is less than dependable because he feels responsible for a massacre in the past. Now, he spends most of his time with a bottle.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Gerald Eskith comes to town claiming to be a deputy marshal. He plans to take the Cartwrights' friend, Jason Blaine, to San Francisco to testify against the Murdock gang. Adam is suspicious and goes along with them.

programme.title: The Legend of 5 Mile Cave
programme.desc: A boy enchanted with tales from the Old West unlocks a mystery that could save their family farm. While his widowed mother struggles to avoid foreclosure, a mysterious stranger arrives looking for a room to rent. A bond with the boy grows as the drifter recounts breathtaking stories of Shooter Green, a legendary gunslinger accused of Arizona's biggest gold robbery. The truth is revealed, along with the secret of the drifter's past when a crooked lawman appears, hot on the trail of the stolen gold. Past and present collide in this tale of action, adventure and drama. Stars Adam Baldwin (The Last Ship, Full Metal Jacket, The Patriot), Jeremy Sumpter (Peter Pan, Soul Surfer), Jill Wagner (Braven, Christmas Cookies), and Jet Jurgensmeyer (Last Man Standing, American Sniper).

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: When failed prospector John Hicks Adams is elected sheriff of Santa Clara County, he must prove that he won't be a bust as a lawman too. Just weeks into the job, his courage is tested when a band of stagecoach robbers begins terrorizing the area.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: After a bank robbery, two Pinkerton detectives join forces to track the notorious Missouri Kid. During a shootout, the Missouri Kid kills seasoned detective Charles Schumacher, leaving young George Dougherty to finish the job and avenge his death.

programme.title: Wagon Train
programme.desc: While on the trail, Annie MacGregor and her Scottish family's wagon wheel breaks. The family patriarch doesn't want any help until Major Adams' wagon train stops. Conflict arises when they practice their traditions, including playing bagpipes.

programme.title: Roll, Thunder, Roll
programme.desc: Red Ryder (Jim Bannon) and Little Beaver (Don Kay Reynolds) help a Mexican Robin Hood framed by raiders.

programme.title: Mason of the Mounted
programme.desc: A young constable searches for a murderer and finds the suspect managing a prosperous horse-stealing gang.

programme.title: Abilene Town
programme.desc: A saloon singer (Ann Dvorak) and her rival like a marshal (Randolph Scott) who cleans up a drunken sheriff's (Edgar Buchanan) cow town.

programme.title: Young Bill Hickok
programme.desc: The frontier hero (Roy Rogers) sings and saves Civil War gold with his sidekick (George "Gabby" Hayes).

programme.title: Colorado
programme.desc: Lieutenant Jerry Burke (Roy Rogers) is sent to Colorado to track down a troublesome gang. When he finally catches them, he finds out his traitorous brother commands them.

programme.title: Jesse James Rides Again
programme.desc: On the run from the law over false charges, Jesse James and his friend find refuge in a small town threatened by a gang trying to claim the oil deposits beneath it. While there, he meets a pretty woman and father who are in danger.

programme.title: Colorado Sundown
programme.desc: Rex (Rex Allen) and Slim (Slim Pickens) journey to Colorado, where Slim is expecting to claim the estate of the departed Zeke Reynolds, but the will also includes Jacqueline Reynolds and the evil Hurley siblings, and a fight ensues.

programme.title: Home in Oklahoma
programme.desc: A singing newsman (Roy Rogers), a ranch foreman (George "Gabby" Hayes) and a newswoman (Dale Evans) team up to track killers.

programme.title: In Old Cheyenne
programme.desc: A singing reporter (Roy Rogers) and a framed man (George "Gabby" Hayes) put a town boss out of business.

programme.title: Public Cowboy, No. 1
programme.desc: Modern-day cattle rustlers use a radio, airplanes and refrigerator trucks to expedite their illegal schemes.

programme.title: Bells of San Angelo
programme.desc: A writer (Dale Evans) of cowboy novels saves herself and a border agent (Roy Rogers) with a trick from her latest book.

programme.title: Man From Music Mountain
programme.desc: A radio-singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) turns sheriff to save a sheep woman (Ruth Terry) from a cattleman (Paul Kelly).

programme.title: The Star Packer
programme.desc: Marshal John Travers investigates the murder of a town's sheriff, makes it his mission to restore order to the town and bring down a bandit called the Shadow.

programme.title: Rage at Dawn
programme.desc: A special agent (Randolph Scott) poses as a train robber to infiltrate Frank Reno's (Forrest Tucker) outlaw gang.

programme.title: Riders of Destiny
programme.desc: Agent Saunders (John Wayne) becomes partners with Fay (Cecelia Parker) to help her fight off a gang run by a local land grabber.

programme.title: The Deadly Companions
programme.desc: An ex-army officer accidentally kills a woman's son and tries to make up for it.

programme.title: West of the Divide
programme.desc: Ted and Dusty infiltrate a band of outlaws to get close to Mr. Gentry, the man who murdered Ted's father.

programme.title: A Romance Wedding

Little does she know her mom has already hired Will to help, an aspiring chef and coincidentally...Zoe’s childhood sweetheart! Tensions rise between Zoe and Will, but so does the chemistry. Will they settle their differences and find lost love along the way?

programme.title: Angel and the Badman

programme.title: A Whirlwind Wedding
programme.desc: Darcy, a talented event planner returns to her home town to plan her mother’s wedding. She’s having trouble accepting her stepfather-to-be and quickly Darcy’s obsession with perfection begins to clash with her mother’s wishes for a low-key celebration —especially when it comes to handsome and charming Kyle, the chef Darcy deems inadequate for catering the event. But as complications arise—both personal and professional—it’s Kyle who is able to help her pull off the big day and help her find the love she’s been looking for…

programme.title: A Wedding to Remember

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We bring you 50 minutes of Strongman inside. Fears, inspiration, courage, the best and worst from our finalists and their expectation of the finals. We also go to Poland and Germany to represent one day in the training of Krzysztof Radzikowski and Dennis Kohlruss. See all the finalists for Mexico in their comfort zone here, with their backgrounds /motivations /family and friends.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The first part of the Strongman Champions League 2018 finals in Mexico. The last twelve athletes all pushing their boundaries and testing their limits to take the World title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

Will Krzysztof manage to take off back or will Dainis maintain his lead?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This year 14 athletes from all over the world came to Fefor to compete in 6 cruel events. programme.title: Strongman Champions League

It’s a FIBO - the biggest expo on planet Earth and the second stage of 2019 Strongman champions league, in Cologne, Germany.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: On a spectacular beach in Alanya, the MLO Strongman Champions League Turkey was viewed by thousands of spectators over a two day battle. With 12 athletes at the start over 6 cruel events, like Marble Stone Lift, Truckpull and Deadlift cars. And with the comeback of Travis Ortmayer / USA, former stone king and world ranked competitor. Winner of several SCL stages in the past.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Four times Strongest Man of Holland, Alex Moonen and the “Flying Dutchman” Kelvin de Ruiter competing here in Holland against 12 other strongest men in the world. There were 6 events in total, and 3 in this episode: The first event, a truckpull of 17.000 kg over 25 meters in max 75 seconds, was a real hard pull Also for the World Champion Truckpull, Holland’s runner-up Kelvin de Ruiter, but watch his amazing technique here.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongest Man of Holland, Alex Moonen and the “Flying Dutchman” Kelvin de Ruiter, competing in Holland against 12 other strongest men in the world. There were 6 events in total, 3 in this second episode; a Viking-press of 150 kg with the current world record holder Luke Herrick. The fifth event, a front hold of 25 kg is loved or hated by the athletes and lastly, the Stones of Strength.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: An unbelievable TANK PULL of 50.000 kg was at the stage of SCL RUSSIA. Never seen this before! Not only a tank pull was done here but also the Viking Press/ Deadlift Max and Log lift reps were spectacular events to see here in Russia. With Mikhail Koklyaev also as event presenter, the former top 3 world strongest man from Russia was there

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this year’s edition on The Balkan Peninsula, we have competing the new talent from Estonia Marko Remlik together with Sebastian Kurek from Poland and yellow leader Kelvin de Ruiter

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Mateusz Kieliszkowski from Poland and Aivars Smaukstelis from Latvia are the strongman future of these days. Mateusz is the best man in the World at the moment to defeat. Only 25 years and such a fantastic strongman. They come here only for a win. But there are 12 more Strong athletes in this episode who want the title of Finland as well.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Mateusz Is leading after day 1 (previous episode) with close behind him Aivars Smaukstelis and Zake Muluzi from the UK. All very exciting! 5 events in this episode: Log Lift, Fram Walk, Deadlift, Sack Throw (Weight for Height), Loading medley.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this stage we have a new strong debutant: Oleg Sylka from the Ukraine. He is the new talent, who will stand up against the old champions like ZSydrunas Savickas and Brian Shaw and the Stoltman Brother from the UK. This new talent Oleg is a great character and we will see him flame in the episode in Portugal.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In Callio is the deepest mine of Europe/ 1500 meter deep, whereas the MLO Strongman Champions League also did 1 event. The Forward Hold, on a 1500 dept/ also a kind of new record/ as it was never done before. Spectacular and new in Strongman sport.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Kelvin de Ruiter is here to defend his SCL World Truck Pull Championships title. But this year, another strong field wants his title. Over 3 different pulls with 3 different trucks, and 14 athletes at the start, it will be difficult for everybody.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL edition Curacao 2019 was a great event, twelve power boys from all over made a great show at the white beaches, and 35 degrees Celsius heat in the Carrabean Islands. Two events were held on Friday at the beach of beautiful resort Sunscape, the other three were held near the world famous floating bridge at Willemstad on Saturday night.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Hosted at Meydan Grandstand in Dubai, the Strongman Champions League had some really big names in the list like Mateusz Kieliszkowski from Poland, Brian Shaw from the USA and Krzysztof Radzikowski. In front of the Burj Khalifa the athletes do the deadlift max and 4 other heavy events at another spot in Dubai.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With new places on the calendar, over 16 stages, broadcasting in over 100 countries and in its 13th year, the MLO Strongman Champions League (SCL) can be seen truly as the biggest strongman league in the world. The last stage over 2 episodes of the MLO Strongman Champions League, were held in Porto, Portugal. This competition in Portugal is full of memorable performances and strong results.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With new places on the calendar, over 16 stages, broadcasting in over 100 countries and in its 13th year, the MLO Strongman Champions League (SCL) can be seen truly as the biggest strongman league in the world. This competition in Portugal is full of memorable performances and strong results and this is the final!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The spectacular Fefor Arena hosted for the 8th time the Worlds Strongest Viking, part of the SCL World Series. But with the absence of former title holders its anyones game. Again, a very spectacular episode of the Strongman Champions League here in Norway.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this episode, the Titan, former double World champion from Latvia will compete against his fellow countryman and the current World champion - Aivars Smaukstelis. With 8 events over 2 stages the contestants are pushed to their limits in Finland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League returns to Doetinchem, Holland, for Stage 5 as athletes resume Day 2 of competition in a tight battle for the SCL title. With only three events remaining, competitors face a brutal sandbag loading race and other heavy tests, as Kevin Hazeleger and Rayno Nel fight for the overall lead.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Dainis Zageris and Aivars Smaukstelis, both from Latvia have a serious, strong battle in the this second and final episode of the SCL Finland 2020. Watch the unbelievable and brute power of these athletes in the last 4 events to crown the winner.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The SCL Germany event takes place in an ancient castle called Die Burg in the heart of Germany. Its here where 5 world record attempts take place across 5 different events with 10 athletes. They will go to the max! See this and much more in the SCL Germany 2020.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Norway is normally all about snow, wind, and cold weather. Our brave athletes are used to compete under conditions few other athletes have competed in, but after COVID delays the competition has been moved from winter to summer bringing in a whole new range of challenges. With an impressive athlete list who will be the winner across 5 cruel events?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Were in sunny Finland for the next stage of a double-bill of SCL action, but this time its a team event. A truly fantastic event with 6000 spectators. Even during COVID times this was exceptional! 8 Strong Teams where fighting for the title over a crazy 9 events.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland, done over 9 cruel events. In this episode the last and final 5 events take place. 8 Strong Teams are fighting for the title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next set of challenges are set in sunny Esposende in Portugal. With stars such as Travis Ortmayer, Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland, and Ervin Toots from Estonia. While Fabio Silva will defend the honour in his own country.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are back in Germany, with the world record breakers. We promise you this is going to be amazing. Do not move from that seat, because we are going to see some records smashed today. Over 6 cruel events, you will see who gets crowned of the King Of The Castle!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With the next episode of Strongman Champions League Germany. Its the world record breakers, and in the last show we set two new records. Can more be records be broken before the king of the castle is crowned?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Kokkola in Finland. This city will be the setting for the Lightweight World championship. Out of 24 athletes, only 16 will make it through to the final day, but who will champion each event and who is going to be eliminated?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Its the second day, and the top 16 athletes have made it through to the final round. With another 4 events to go who will get the crown of world champion?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Ukraine and the wonderful capital city of Kyiv. Were here for the second time for the iconic truck pull World Championships! The reigning World champion Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland will defend his title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this episode, a final chance for our athletes to get vital world series ranking points on board to give them the best possible chance of success and an initial advantage at the finals. It's the last show before the world finals and the top 10 places are up for grabs, but who will they be?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkeys south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season. Here in the sunshine, well finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is - you could not ask for a better setting. Aivars Smaukstellis, the reigning world champion is defending his title, and two-time world champion Dainis Zageris is also here, but with a though competition, who will win?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: What a day ahead of us here in Alanya, just a handful of events to go before we find out who will be the winner of Strongman Champions League in 2021. These are the world finals, and all the big names are in the house. With just 3 events to go - who will take the crown of World Champion 2021 and be the STRONGEST?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are back, after a short break it feels like we never even left. We’re here in Vaasa - Finland kicking off 2022 new world series. If you are watching at home, just like these people, you’re in the right place. Because this is a special edition world record breaker. The only question left today, is to see how many new world records will be set so stay tuned.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are here in Doetinchem – Holland, for Stage 2 and 3 in the hottest day of the year. 40-degree heat, these boys have to work harder than they ever have. The sun is going to be beating down, they’re going to be sweating, hydration is going to be key today. I also reckon they’re all going to be wearing their sunglasses. Let’s see which shady looking character wins.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: So there you have it. The next day, 3 more events in 40 Degrees heat. We’ve got Gavin coming into day 2 leading the pack. Kelvin De Ruiter our world champion struggling a little bit at the moment, but Yoke Race, Conan’s Wheel and then Stones to finish. There is a lot to be played for here, so stay tuned to see if Gavin can take the lead and beat Kelvin overall.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We’re in the Serbian city of Novi kozarci, for the next stage in the world series. And what a fantastic line up we have for you again. But it is going to be one of the hottest stages yet. A Strongman competition in 44-degree heat. It will be a real challenge for these athletes to finish this event. From all over the world the strongmen came here for the title! Welcome to the heat hell in Serbia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to day 2 in Serbia, and its another baking hot one. We are in Kikinda today! We’ve got three more gruelling events for our athletes. Sami Ahola is leading the pack, so can he be the first Finnish athlete to take an SCL title. Stay tuned to find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this competition, we have our athletes paired up. They’re going to have to take on each event together, having to factor in each other’s strengths and possibly weaknesses. Can the men who normally work alone, share their powers as a duo? Let’s find out!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland- Joensuu. Welcome to the final day of the world’s strongest team event. The race to be the best team in the world is coming to its crowing point. All is still wide open for any of these to take the title. Who is going to win? Will team Latvia keep their World Title or maybe Finland can attach them? Keep watching and we’ll find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome back to Strongman Champions League for another stage of the 2022 world tour. We’re in Esposende - Portugal in this beautiful setting next to the beach in front of a packed crowd with some of the strongest men the world has to offer. With a real Porsche deadlift and many other crazy stuff. So, lets get this show started.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Hello and welcome in Gloucester, UK. The world tour hasn’t been here for what feels like forever. And now for the first time in the Mekka of Strongman, the SCL World series will crown a great Champion with the SCL Title. It will be full with special wooden events, and a great winner! So ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, brace yourselves because I present to you strongman champions league UK.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland the home of Legends Mariusz Pudzianowkski and Krzystof Radzikowski. Who will grab the title here in holiday resort Sopot, on the great Balrtic Sea with 6 events and 12 athlets in the mix!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland, after 3 events the Polish Strongman Oskar Ziolkowski is Leading. Kelvin, Travis and Aivars are coming up and will try to beat him, but will Oskar take his first title ever?
